newsitem.title: USA: Bell Atlantic-NYNEX Mobile picks DSC's INfusion.
newsitem.headline: Bell Atlantic-NYNEX Mobile picks DSC's INfusion.

text.p: DSC Communications Corp said Tuesday that its INfusion signal transfer point system has been chosen by Bell Atlantic NYNEX Mobile for its wireless network.
Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed.
Bell Atlantic NYNEX Mobile is a Bedminster, N.J.,-based wireless communications services company. It is a joint venture in which Bell Atlantic Corp holds a 62 percent stake and NYNEX Corp 38 percent.

DSC said its INfusion system provides high-performance packet switching for basic and advanced communications services such as call set-up, caller name and caller identification, toll free services using the 800 and 888 telephone numbers and access to home and visitor location register databases.
DSC makes and markets digital switching, transmission, access and private network system products for worldwide telecommunications. INfusion is a trademark of DSC.
